idea-plugin.name: STAMP Annotations
idea-plugin.description:
Shows, beside each line of a file, the STAMP that introduced it: the commit, as the Status, Time, Author, Module and Path coordinates a Tinkar version carries. The attribution comes from a first-parent history walk over the repository, honoring .git-blame-ignore-revs, so a formatting reflow never takes authorship. Lines changed in the editor but not yet committed show no STAMP: theirs is made at commit time.

Annotate with STAMPs (gutter menu, VCS menu) opens the gutter; clicking a STAMP highlights every line it introduced. Affirm Selected Lines records review of a range as an empty signed commit carrying Affirms: trailers, which the walker will attach to those lines under the affirmed role.

Design: dev-stamp-adoc-attribution and dev-stamp-affirmation in ike-lab-documents; tracked in IKE-Network/ike-issues#468.

action.description: Show, beside each line, the STAMP (commit) that introduced it
Record an empty signed commit whose Affirms trailers cover the selected lines as committed at HEAD
